title: FAQ support assistant
problem: Customers ask questions about approved policies.
lab: Answer from a small FAQ with source IDs.
production: Reject missing evidence; log references and evaluate helpfulness.
choice: Simple retrieval-backed answer vs autonomous agent.

title: Support-ticket triage and routing
problem: Turn inbound tickets into typed routes.
lab: Return category and priority JSON and route to a mock queue.
production: Validate all fields, handle ambiguity and add human override.
choice: Rules or classifier vs generative model.

title: Order-status tool agent
problem: A user asks about their order.
concepts: Tool calling, read-only authority, tool loops
lab: Build get_order_status() with a bounded agent loop.
production: Authorize order ownership, limit calls and trace results.
choice: Direct API access vs tool-access abstraction.

title: Document intake and extraction
problem: Convert invoices into validated records.
lab: Parse synthetic invoices into typed JSON.
production: Handle duplicates, malware, privacy and manual correction.

title: Read-only analytics copilot
problem: Users ask natural-language questions of business data.
lab: Query a sandbox SQLite dataset and show a chart.
production: Enforce row policy, read-only access, timeouts and query tracing.
choice: Model-written SQL vs governed metrics service.

title: Research report generator
problem: Create a short evidence-based report.
lab: Search mock source documents and cite passages.
production: Handle contradicting sources, time freshness and missing citations.

title: Email draft-and-send assistant
problem: Draft correspondence and send only when approved.
lab: Draft a sample email, show preview and mock send after approval.
production: Reauthorize sender/recipient, prevent duplicate sends and audit.

title: Goal-to-task planning assistant
problem: Turn a goal into executable safe steps.
concepts: Agent planner, loop budgets, stopping conditions
lab: Plan three mock steps and execute bounded tool calls.
production: Control recursion, cost, partial failures and authorization.

title: Local ticket-lookup MCP server
problem: Let a compatible AI host inspect local ticket records.
lab: Make list_tickets and get_ticket tools with a local test client.
production: Validate arguments, restrict fields and test errors.
choice: Direct function tools vs reusable MCP service.

title: Remote CRM MCP server
problem: Access CRM data through a remote MCP service.
lab: Serve mock CRM tools using an official SDK.
production: HTTPS, scoped credentials, timeouts and compatibility checks.

title: MCP tool gateway
problem: Several teams own MCP servers with overlapping tools.
lab: Route to three mock MCP services behind one catalog.
production: Tool allowlists, origin checks, quotas and auditing.
choice: Direct host integration vs brokered governance.

title: Internal knowledge exposed as MCP resources
problem: Clients need controlled document reads.
concepts: MCP resources vs tools vs prompts
lab: Expose versioned policy texts as resources.
production: Source ACLs, freshness and deletion handling.
choice: Resource read vs search tool invocation.

title: Reusable MCP prompt catalog
problem: Teams reuse guided workflows in compatible hosts.
lab: Publish parameterized support and incident prompts.
production: Review content, safe defaults, compatibility and ownership.

title: Enterprise MCP authorization broker
problem: Users grant limited access to internal SaaS services.
lab: Simulate per-user scoped CRM access.
production: Deny token passthrough, confused-deputy access and cross-tenant calls.
choice: User delegation vs shared service credentials.

title: Multi-tenant MCP service
problem: Multiple customers share a service without sharing data.
lab: Test isolated tenant ticket queries.
production: Enforce tenancy at data access and budget layers.
choice: Shared multi-tenant endpoint vs isolated deployment.

title: Scalable MCP catalog and lookup
problem: Hundreds of tools make tool selection noisy.
lab: Filter a fake 100-tool catalog by user intent.
production: Version schemas, cap context and handle stale discovery.
choice: Expose all tools vs curated selection.

title: Long-running report via MCP Tasks
problem: Reporting exceeds interactive request duration.
concepts: MCP Tasks optional extension, async lifecycle
lab: Simulate job start, status, cancel and result retrieval.
production: Persist task identity, reconcile retries and support clients without Tasks.
choice: Synchronous call vs async task pattern.

title: Document Q&A with RAG
problem: Answer questions from an internal document set.
lab: Index sample files and cite passages.
production: Evaluate retrieval, support deletions and source ACLs.

title: Permission-aware enterprise search
problem: Two users must see different document results.
lab: Search a mock HR/engineering corpus under different users.
production: Enforce security trimming before leaking snippets.
choice: Pre-filter vs post-filter and index separation.

title: Hybrid search and reranking
problem: Find both product identifiers and semantic matches.
lab: Compare lexical, semantic and hybrid results.
production: Tune relevance, latency, freshness and cost.

title: Customer 360 evidence assistant
problem: Combine CRM records, orders and policy text.
lab: Join mock SQL order tools with indexed policies.
production: Enforce source-level permissions and reconcile conflicts.
choice: Tool federation vs centralized data model.

title: Long-term assistant memory
problem: Persist only useful user-approved information.
lab: Save, retrieve, inspect and delete explicit preferences.
production: Consent, privacy, stale entries, prompt injection.

title: Multilingual policy assistant
problem: Answer policy questions across two languages.
lab: Create bilingual source-backed Q&A.
production: Evaluate language-specific accuracy and caveats.

title: Near-real-time knowledge indexing
problem: User changes must appear promptly in AI answers.
concepts: CDC, events, index refresh and tombstones
lab: Update a local search index from mock change events.
production: Ordering, replay, access revocation and rebuild.

title: Evidence verification agent
problem: Find unsupported statements in an analysis.
lab: Flag claims not backed by cited source excerpts.
production: Handle false citations, conflicting evidence and uncertainty.
choice: Model self-check vs independent source verification.

title: IT incident investigator
problem: Investigate a mock service outage from logs and metrics.
lab: Query mock monitoring tools and create a timeline.
production: Least-privilege read access, query caps, failures and audit.
choice: Scripted runbook vs autonomous diagnostic loop.

title: Plan-execute research workflow
problem: Complete a multi-step research assignment.
lab: Build plan -> retrieve -> synthesize -> cite.
production: Resume partial runs and bound plan revisions.

title: Refund approval agent
problem: Propose a refund with approval before execution.
lab: Simulate proposal -> user approval -> mock refund.
production: Approval expiry, amount caps, audit and unknown outcomes.

title: Supplier onboarding agent
problem: Onboarding spans documents and departments.
lab: Simulate document checks and waiting for review.
production: Crash resume, cancellations, compensation and SLA.
choice: Agent loop vs durable workflow engine.

title: Parallel contract comparison
problem: Compare several contracts efficiently.
lab: Analyze sample documents and aggregate differences.
production: Bound parallelism, isolate errors and trace evidence.

title: Event-triggered operations assistant
problem: A monitoring alert triggers an AI investigation.
lab: Publish fake alerts and launch controlled investigation.
production: Debounce storms, retry safely and limit authority.

title: Large batch classification agent
problem: Classify a high volume of cases.
lab: Batch route synthetic tickets through model profiles.
production: Dead letters, spend ceilings, throughput and fairness.
choice: Online interactive vs offline batch execution.

title: Crash-recoverable agent runtime
problem: Agent crashes after an external step.
lab: Kill and restart a local workflow without repeating side effects.
production: Reconcile unknown action status and checkpoints.
choice: Replay whole plan vs resume committed steps.

title: AI sales dashboard from structured answers
problem: Show a chart instead of a paragraph.
lab: Render a typed chart in self-contained HTML.
production: Schema validation, escaping, a11y and printable fallback.
choice: Fixed UI vs model-selected approved components.

title: Conversational configuration wizard
problem: Update a form based on conversational preferences.
lab: Build a native HTML wizard from an approved field registry.
production: Repeat authorization on submit; handle stale state.
choice: Trusted components vs generated raw code.

title: Expense-analysis MCP App
problem: Embed expense charts within compatible chat hosts.
concepts: MCP Apps ui:// resources, host bridge, sandbox
lab: Attach HTML view to MCP expense summary tool.
production: Host compatibility, authorization, isolation and text fallback.
choice: MCP Apps vs plain tool result.

title: Ticket-approval MCP App
problem: Approve a proposed ticket action inside chat.
lab: Build a sandboxed action panel with mock backend.
production: Server-side approver authority, expiry, audit, replay protection.
choice: App-view action vs model-triggered tool call.

title: Live incident console with AG-UI
problem: Stream an investigation into a first-party application.
concepts: Run lifecycle, event streams and state deltas
lab: Render a live incident timeline from mock AG-UI-like events.
production: Resume cursor, tool-payload redaction and cancellation.

title: Declarative A2UI request form
problem: A remote agent proposes a form using approved native components.
lab: Render allowlisted UI nodes in plain HTML.
production: Restrict components/actions and enforce schema versions.

title: Portable UI comparison lab
problem: Show same results in chat and standalone web app.
lab: Build both MCP App and first-party HTML views on one data contract.
production: Capability fallback, accessibility and version skew.

title: Enterprise agent cockpit
problem: Combine chat, progress and an editable workspace.
lab: Build two-pane HTML agent console with event timeline.
production: Concurrent edits, policy checks, reconnection and tracing.

title: Supervisor and specialist investigators
problem: Delegate log, metric and change-history research.
lab: Coordinate three mock specialist agents.
production: Bound recursion, filter context and resolve disagreements.
choice: Many tools on one agent vs specialists.

title: Remote fraud specialist via A2A
problem: Ask an independently deployed agent to score a case.
concepts: A2A Agent Cards, task and artifact flow
lab: Call a fake external specialist by A2A-compatible interface.
production: Authenticate boundary, validate artifacts and correlate tasks.
choice: Local handoff vs A2A remote agent.

title: Multi-vendor agent broker
problem: Select between agents from different providers.
lab: Route sample requests to two mock agents.
production: Capabilities trust, quota, health and data routing.
choice: Static routing vs dynamic agent registry.

title: Long-running A2A research task
problem: Remote research remains pending during other work.
lab: Start, poll/cancel and collect mock task artifact.
production: Durable status, task ACL, late results and expiry.

title: Customer-service handoff network
problem: Triage user problems to billing or technical agents.
lab: Implement typed triage/handoff to mock specialists.
production: Avoid history leakage and unclear responsibility.

title: Multi-agent peer review
problem: A second agent checks the first report.
lab: Produce two analyses and deterministic reconciliation.
production: Correlated errors, budgets and human accountability.
choice: One agent with self-review vs independent checks.

title: Cross-organization procurement assistants
problem: Buyer and supplier systems exchange bounded quotes.
lab: Exchange fake quotes between two hosted agents.
production: Price bounds, signed terms and audit.

title: Enterprise agent directory
problem: Operators need a governed catalog of agents.
lab: Search sample Agent Cards.
production: Approve provenance, revoke access and version endpoints.

title: Injection-resistant knowledge assistant
problem: A retrieved page tries to instruct the model to call a privileged tool.
lab: Test malicious document and show external policy blocks an action.
production: Independent authorizer, sandbox and red-team tests.
choice: Prompt wording vs hard technical enforcement.

title: Central policy engine for agent actions
problem: Agents share write-capable business tools.
lab: Place a policy check before a mock write action.
production: Fail-safe policy, audit, revocation and versioning.

title: Delegated identity across MCP
problem: Agent calls the user's CRM securely.
lab: Mock per-user credentials and revocation.
production: Server-side verification, token handling and tenant isolation.

title: Computer-use assistant sandbox
problem: Work in a legacy UI without an API.
lab: Fill a local fake admin form with a preview gate.
production: Limit network, secrets, downloads and domain access.
choice: API integration vs computer use fallback.

title: Sensitive-document AI workspace
problem: Support restricted contract analysis.
lab: Query synthetic sensitive documents with role-based access.
production: Minimize prompt exposure, redact and honor deletion.
choice: Central knowledge base vs isolated store.

title: Multi-tenant agent platform
problem: Run many customer agents on shared infrastructure.
lab: Isolate two simulated tenants' state and credentials.
production: Audit, noisy-neighbor controls and cross-tenant tests.
choice: Shared runtime vs dedicated tenant deployment.

title: Auditable payment-operations copilot
problem: Investigate payment problems without moving funds autonomously.
lab: Propose remediation using fake transaction records.
production: Separation of duties, idempotency, unknown outcomes.

title: Agent supply-chain security
problem: Agents load third-party tools and instruction packs.
concepts: Supply-chain provenance, manifest and capability review
lab: Check an allowlisted local skill/tool registry.
production: Version pinning, sandboxing, signature/review and revocation.

title: Agent tracing and evaluation dashboard
problem: Diagnose a broken agent run.
lab: Trace synthetic model/tool calls and render a summary.
production: Redact spans, correlate across MCP/A2A and sample.

title: Grounded-answer regression suite
problem: A new prompt may improve one case but break others.
concepts: Golden datasets, grounding and eval criteria
lab: Compare two mock assistant versions on 30 cases.
production: Repeated runs, human adjudication and release gates.

title: Model gateway and fallback
problem: Route tasks by quality, price and latency.
lab: Use two mock model backends for simple/complex tasks.
production: Rate/cost caps, privacy and fallback quality.

title: High-load agent admission control
problem: Bursts exceed provider quotas.
lab: Prioritize interactive over batch work.
production: Shed load, tenant fairness, expiration and observability.

title: Replay-safe external actions
problem: A tool call timed out after an unknown side effect.
lab: Simulate duplicate sends after a crash.
production: Use stable request IDs, action ledger and status query.
choice: Retry blindly vs reconcile before retry.

title: Safe prompt and agent rollout
problem: Release new prompts, models and tools gradually.
lab: Compare candidate versions on sample traffic.
production: Gate on task quality, schemas and checkpoint compatibility.

title: Agent service SLO and on-call
problem: Team needs measurable agent service health.
lab: Define fake metrics and operational dashboard.
production: Distinguish infra errors from model failures.

title: Multi-region agent disaster recovery
problem: Region failure interrupts agent execution.
lab: Restore a mock workflow to a secondary environment.
production: Reconcile effects, secrets and recovery drills.

title: Browser-based travel-admin agent
problem: Work with forms in systems lacking tool APIs.
lab: Preview changes in a fake travel site without submitting.
production: Layout drift, credential isolation, allowlist and stop rules.

title: Realtime voice support assistant
problem: Support a live spoken conversation.
lab: Stream fake transcript turns into a support workflow.
production: Consent, redaction, latency and human transfer.

title: Visual claims-inspection assistant
problem: Analyze user-uploaded images for damage evidence.
lab: Create a structured report using synthetic photos.
production: Privacy, evidence provenance and human final decision.
choice: Vision-only vs deterministic checks plus review.

title: Code-editing agent in sandbox
problem: Fix a failing test and propose a patch.
lab: Modify a toy repo in an isolated workspace.
production: No secrets or network, capped runs and review gates.
choice: Model writes code vs bounded edit/test agent.

title: Agent Skills registry and discovery
problem: Package reusable workflow guidance.
lab: Create three local toy skills and a selector.
production: Trust review, script isolation and version pinning.

title: AI workflow builder with visual steps
problem: Generate an editable workflow for non-coders.
concepts: Workflow schema, components and static validation
lab: Render a JSON-defined graph in plain HTML.
production: Validate cycles, permissions and publish approval.
choice: Arbitrary generated code vs constrained DSL.

title: Code-and-data analysis workspace
problem: Generate repeatable charts from sample data.
lab: Run Python analysis of fake CSV and save charts.
production: Bound CPU/network, lineage and dependency lock.

title: Unified enterprise agentic platform
problem: Govern assistants, UIs, MCP, remote agents and operations.
concepts: Control/data planes, protocols, security and evaluation
lab: Integrate one agent, two tools, a UI and remote specialist.
production: Multi-tenancy, tracing, rollout, DR and policy enforcement.
